name: io.github.chrischall/maxpreps-mcp
description: MaxPreps MCP — high school schedules, scores, records, rosters and stat leaders

environmentVariables.name: MAXPREPS_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Optional override for the User-Agent sent to MaxPreps.

environmentVariables.name: MAXPREPS_CACHE_TTL
environmentVariables.description: Seconds to cache a page response. Default 300; 0 disables caching.

environmentVariables.name: MAXPREPS_MIN_INTERVAL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum spacing between requests, in ms. Default 250.
